name: Fists Up
description:
Whenever you spend an action to make an unarmed melee attack on your turn, you may make one attack per free hand.

Whenever you land a hit with an unarmed melee attack or with an improvised weapon, roll 1d6 for the damage.

These effects are suspended while you are wearing armor of martial grade or higher.

Describe how your stripped-down style delivers a brutal blow.

improvements.name: Fists of Fury
improvements.description: Your damage die for unarmed melee attacks and attacks with improvised weapons is a d8.

improvements.name: Sting Like A Bee
improvements.description: Your damage die for unarmed melee attacks and attacks with improvised weapons is a d10.
